summary: ICP canister dapp scaffolded with a Motoko backend and a React + Tailwind (shadcn/ui) frontend for an interactive romantic/“surprise” experience, including Internet Identity login gating, configurable memory sections (images/videos), popups (love letter/proposal), and animated visual effects, packaged with build/deploy templates for IC.
architectural_notes: Frontend uses React + Vite with TailwindCSS and shadcn/ui component set.
Authentication integrates Internet Identity; app access is gated via a session/lock screen flow.
Content is largely config-driven (messages and image/video memory configs).
Includes IC canister scaffolding (Motoko backend, Candid bindings) plus deploy/build template scripts.

Media Manager 'Submit' action should atomically apply/publish all staged media changes so the Image section shows all submitted photos and the Video section shows all submitted videos after submission.
Media Manager should provide per-slot controls to add/replace media from phone gallery across Hero, Image grid, and Video grid; include drag/reorder and per-item adjust flows.
known_issues: Media Manager "Submit" button is not working (click does not apply/publish staged draft changes).
After attempting to submit, not all uploaded/staged images become visible in the Image Memory section as expected.
Uploaded Hero section background image is not visible after using the media add/replace flow (no visible result).
Uploaded/replaced images are not visible in the Image Memory section after using the media add/replace flow (no visible result).
Image Memory section shows a pink blank page/popup instead of displaying the uploaded image(s).
Clicking an uploaded image should show the configured popup message, but currently shows a pink/blank popup instead.
Production deployment/publish of the latest draft fails with a deployment error.

existing_features.title: Motoko backend canister scaffold
existing_features.description: Backend canister implemented in Motoko (main.mo) with generated Candid bindings and frontend actor typing integration.

existing_features.title: React + Vite frontend scaffold with Tailwind and shadcn/ui components
existing_features.description: Frontend built with React/Vite and TailwindCSS, including a large set of shadcn/ui components and utility hooks/config.

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication and session gating
existing_features.description: Client-side authentication via Internet Identity with hooks to manage identity/actor and gate access to the experience behind a lock/session screen.

existing_features.title: Config-driven romantic experience content
existing_features.description: Centralized configuration for romantic messages and memory content (image/video memory configs) used to drive UI sections.

existing_features.title: Interactive experience UI: hero, surprise section, and popups
existing_features.description: Core experience screens/sections including HeroSection, SurpriseSection, IntroPopup, LoveLetterPopup, and ProposalPopup components.

existing_features.title: Memory sections for images and videos
existing_features.description: Dedicated UI sections for displaying image and video memories (ImageMemorySection, VideoMemorySection) driven by config.

existing_features.title: Music player component
existing_features.description: Frontend MusicPlayer component for playing audio as part of the experience.

existing_features.title: Animated romantic visual effects
existing_features.description: Animated UI effects/components including FloatingHearts and RosePetals plus supporting UI elements (e.g., FlipImageCard).

existing_features.title: IC build/deploy template and repository scaffolding
existing_features.description: Build template assets including Dockerfile, scripts for pruning/resizing images, IC canister YAMLs, workspace/package configs, and deploy.sh for IC deployment.

existing_features.title: Add a frontend-only media upload + persistence flow that lets the user pick files from their phone gallery and have the app display those files (and keep them after refresh) for: (1) the Hero section background, (2) the Image Memory section images, and (3) the Video Memory section videos.

Implement a simple in-app "Media" management UI (mobile-first) that provides controls to: upload/replace the hero background image, bulk upload/replace Image Memory photos, and bulk upload/replace Video Memory videos; include clear English labels and brief instructions in the UI.

Update HeroSection, ImageMemorySection/imageMemoryData usage, and VideoMemorySection/videoMemoryData usage so that each media reference first checks for an uploaded file (from the local persisted store) and otherwise uses the existing static placeholder paths.
Update frontend/public/PLACEHOLDER_MEDIA_README.txt to document the new in-app phone-gallery upload option while keeping the existing "drop files into frontend/public" replacement method intact.

Update the Image Memory grid so that the specific selected card element (/html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/section[2]/div[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div[1]/div[1]/div[1]) displays the user-provided uploaded image (Snapchat-390521611.jpg) as its front image.

Update the existing Media Manager popup (dialog) so that media changes (uploads/replacements/clears/reorders) are staged as a pending draft and are only applied to the live app after the user clicks a new primary action button labeled "Submit".
Add drag-and-drop support in the Media Manager Images grid to let the user drag an image slot and drop it onto another slot to reorder/swap images before submitting.

Add an "Adjust" control for each uploaded image slot in the Media Manager that opens a simple adjustment UI allowing the user to reposition (pan) and zoom the image within its frame, with the adjustment saved and applied in both the Media Manager preview and the Image Memory grid after submit.

Update the Media Manager “Submit” flow so that when the user clicks Submit, all staged (draft) image uploads become visible in the Image Memory section immediately (without requiring a refresh), respecting the draft image order and any saved per-slot adjustments (pan/zoom).
Update the Media Manager “Submit” flow so that when the user clicks Submit, all staged (draft) video uploads become visible in the Video Memory section immediately (without requiring a refresh).

Ensure the Media Manager draft state is initialized from the current persisted/live media state when the dialog opens (current image order, current transforms, and currently uploaded media), so Submit publishes changes relative to what the user already has.

When applying a submitted draft, handle all supported draft operations consistently for both images and videos, including clearing a slot (if the draft indicates a clear) so the corresponding section falls back to its placeholder media for that slot.

Fix the Media Manager "Submit" button so that clicking it reliably publishes the staged draft changes (hero/image/video uploads, clears, reorders, and per-slot image adjustments) to the live MediaStore state without requiring a refresh.

Ensure the Media Manager "Submit" button becomes enabled whenever there are meaningful pending draft changes, including image reordering changes and image transform (pan/zoom) changes, not only new uploads/clears.

Make all uploaded images visible in the Image Memory section after Submit by ensuring the Image Memory grid renders using the latest MediaStoreContext state (uploaded image URLs, current image order, and current transforms) immediately after draft publication.

Fix MediaStoreContext state updates so multiple sequential uploads/clears in a single Submit do not overwrite each other due to stale React state closures (especially for imageUrls and videoUrls Maps). Ensure that uploading/replacing multiple images (or videos) in one submit results in all corresponding slots being updated in the live store state.

Ensure the Media Manager Submit action reliably publishes all draft changes (hero upload/clear, image upload/clear, video upload/clear, image order changes, and image transform changes) every time the user clicks Submit, and that the dialog closes only after publication completes successfully.

Add lightweight in-app debugging visibility for the Submit flow to help identify why users might not see uploaded images (e.g., log a single structured console message per submit with counts of uploaded/cleared images/videos and whether imageOrder/transforms changed). All user-facing text must be in English.

Update the in-app Media Manager UX so mobile users can add/replace media per slot without relying on hover, including per-image-slot controls for Upload/Replace, Adjust, Clear, and drag-to-reorder images.
Ensure the Hero section 'Media' (top/right) entry point clearly provides access to uploading/replacing media for all sections: Hero background, all Image Memory slots, and all Video Memory slots.
Add support for uploading/replacing/clearing a background song (audio file) from the phone gallery/device storage inside the Media Manager, and persist it locally so it survives refreshes.
Add a simple user-facing way to control whether uploaded videos play with sound (voice) or muted in the Video Memories section, without breaking existing uploads and fallbacks.

Fix MediaStoreContext object-URL lifecycle so uploaded Image Memory images do not get revoked during normal React re-renders/updates (which currently causes images to fail loading and fall back to the pink error/placeholder). Object URLs should only be revoked when they are being replaced/cleared or when the app is truly unmounting.

In the Image Memory grid, ensure that tapping/clicking a card reliably reveals the configured message for that memory (the existing reveal interaction may be a flip or another in-place reveal), and that the message reveal does not appear as a blank/pink-only view.
Identify the root cause of the production publish/deployment failure and implement the necessary fixes so the latest draft can be deployed to production without errors.
Improve deployment failure diagnostics so that if a publish/deploy fails again, the error output includes the actionable underlying cause (not only a generic "Deployment error").

Add a pre-publish verification step to the deploy workflow to catch common publish blockers before attempting production deployment (e.g., frontend build failing, missing required artifacts, misconfigured canister/deploy settings).

new_feature_requests.summary: Support custom background image for the Hero section (configurable/replacable).
Allow replacing/updating Image Memory section images with photos from the user’s phone gallery (upload/selection flow).
Allow adding/replacing videos in the Video Memory section with user-provided memorable videos (upload/selection flow).
Add a 'Media Manager' mode to manage the 43-image grid and 6-video grid, enabling one-by-one upload/replace from the user’s phone gallery before publishing.
Add a Submit button to the Media adding popup so changes are only applied/sorted after submitting.
Enable dragging/adjusting images in the media manager (e.g., reorder and/or reposition/crop within a frame).
Add support for managing video audio: allow videos with/without original voice and let user add/replace a song/background audio track after uploading (via Media Manager).
